relationship_to_v0: Post-v0 exploratory design prompted by the inability of the v0 per-stratum Bonferroni bound to certify small Shapley values under sparse marginal sampling. The same game is retained, but all evaluation seeds below are unseen by this v1 holdout at preregistration time. This is a confirmatory holdout on the fixed game, not an independent-game generalization test.

game.definition: v(S)=1 iff S contains at least one minimal_support; otherwise 0

sampling.oracle_cost: one exact v(S) observation per sampled unique coalition; no cached lookup charge

certifier.assumption_class: all monotone functions x:2^[10]->[0,1] matching every sampled exact oracle value
certifier.constraints: 0<=x_S<=1 and x_S<=x_{S union {j}} for every Boolean-lattice cover relation; sampled vertices are fixed to observed 0/1 values
certifier.player_objective: maximize sum_{S not containing i} |S|!(n-|S|-1)!/n! * (x_{S union {i}}-x_S)
certifier.solver: linear programming; the feasible region is a face of the Boolean-lattice order polytope
certifier.integrality_rationale: Vertices of an order polytope are 0/1 indicator functions of upper sets, so the LP optimum is attained by a monotone binary completion. Fixing observed 0/1 coordinates restricts to a face and does not weaken the upper-bound claim.
certifier.source: Stanley order-polytope vertex characterization; see e.g. Proposition 7.4 in Develin et al., Morphisms and Order Ideals of Toric Posets, citing Stanley Corollary 1.3.
certifier.certification_rule: For threshold epsilon, certify phi_i<=epsilon iff the LP maximum U_i over all monotone completions consistent with observations is <= epsilon.
certifier.safety_claim_scope: Deterministic conditional upper bound under exact oracle values and the monotone-function assumption only; no claim outside that class.

metrics: per-budget certification rate for rare players 8 and 9
median and p95 LP upper bound
false-certification count against exact game truth
earliest unique-call budget that certifies each rare player

comparison.v0_reference: Report v0 size-stratified fixed-time hypergeometric/Bonferroni certification separately; do not retrofit v1 into v0.

next_action: Read this protocol back unchanged, then run exactly seeds 1000..1999 at the frozen budgets and thresholds.
